description_en: Deletes traffic destinations from an endpoint
description_zh: 调用DeleteCustomRoutingEndpointTrafficPolicies接口删除终端节点流量通行目标
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-custom-routing-endpoint-traffic-policies --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-id ep-2zewuzypq5e6r3pfh0000 --policy-ids ply-bptest20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCustomRoutingEndpointTrafficPolicies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the endpoint for which you want to delete traffic destinations.

This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
待删除流量通行目标的终端节点ID。

该参数为必选
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the traffic destinations.

You can specify the IDs of up to 9,000 traffic destinations
parameters.help_zh:
流量通行目标ID列表。

您最多可输入9000个流量通行目标ID
parameters.name: policy_ids
